entry.title: FedEx, UPS delivery prices set for record-high Q4
entry.summary: Easing fuel prices and a discounting activity rebound offered relief in Q3, but peak season surcharges will turn up the heat, according to the TD Cowen/AFS Freight Index.

entry.title: FMC proposes fees on Spanish-flagged vessels, import restrictions
entry.summary: The Federal Maritime Commission wants to impose a $200,000 per-voyage fee on Spanish-flagged vessels and restrict certain goods from the country.

entry.title: From library to logistics: Cathy Morrow Roberson shares career insights
entry.summary: “There are so many more opportunities today than there were when I started my business," the managing director of Logistics Trends & Insights told Supply Chain Dive.

entry.title: The biggest risk in agentic commerce isn’t easy to see. It’s invisibility.
entry.summary: As AI agents shortlist products for shoppers, incomplete data can mean lost sales.

entry.title: Supply chain visibility tells you what happened. Can you see what it cost?
entry.summary: Supply chain visibility can tell you what happened. Transportation Financial Intelligence™ helps explain what it cost, why it happened and what should happen next.

entry.title: Unlocking the autonomous supply chain: Why execution data has to feed the plan
entry.summary: Ditch the war room. Build a supply chain that learns and adapts autonomously.

entry.title: Port of Savannah to build 3.5M TEU container terminal
entry.summary: The port expects to be able to handle 12 million TEUs annually once construction is complete.

entry.title: Walmart approves 8 more parcel carriers for seller-fulfilled shipping
entry.summary: The retailer's marketplace now allows businesses to use DoorDash, UniUni and others if they are managing deliveries themselves.

entry.title: Few major apparel brands pay garment workers a living wage: report
entry.summary: Out of 110 clothing brands — including Adidas, Chanel and Zara — only four disclose workers’ wage levels at garment factories in their supply chains, a new report from Clean Clothes Campaign found.

entry.title: Cutter & Buck eyes fulfillment boost with second automated distribution center
entry.summary: The apparel brand’s new site in Grand Prairie, Texas, features over 50,000 storage bins and is equipped to process more than 1,200 bins per hour.
